name: Number Five Orange
blurb: The whole city becomes a VIP room — nightlife capitalism and the cover-charge economy in safety-cone orange and gold.

stages.title: The Mood
stages.blurb: Moodboards — the texture, palette and references the kit grows from.

images.caption: Velvet rope stanchion, pink VIP wristband and cover-charge clipboard on circuit-board background
images.prompt: Still life of a velvet VIP rope on a brass stanchion, a tear-off paper wristband, and a door-list clipboard. No people. Premium hospitality nightlife props, official-merch lighting.

images.caption: Sponsor-board tagline bank with VANCOUVER crest and scathing nightlife slogans
images.prompt: A sheet of official-looking sponsor-board / ticker tagline bars, darkly funny and scathing, each set like a tournament sponsor wordmark in gold or white on safety-cone orange and vinyl black: "WORLD-CLASS NIGHTLIFE / WORKING-CLASS WAGES", "OPEN FOR TOURISTS / CLOSED FOR LOCALS", "PUBLIC LAND, PRIVATE CHAMPAGNE ROOM", "COVER CHARGE AT THE DOOR OF YOUR OWN CITY", "WE POLICE THE WORKERS / WE PROMOTE THE PARTY". Clean sans-serif, official sports branding aesthetic. white background.

stages.title: The Marks
stages.blurb: Crests, patterns, nameplates, numbers and typography — the language of the kit.

images.caption: Orange and gold WORK IS WORK sponsor bar with #5Orange fee tagline
images.prompt: A professional sponsor bar / brand bar, text reads "WORK IS WORK", styled like a telecom or airline carrier wordmark, clean confident sans-serif, metallic gold on a safety-cone orange rectangle, official tournament sponsor aesthetic. white background.

images.caption: Champagne/gold long sleeve detail with COVER CHARGE stamp repeat and fee cuff tab
images.prompt: Technical fashion flat showing sleeve detail of the champagne-room third kit, cover-charge rubber-stamp marks repeating down the sleeve in gold and orange, a dirty-gold gloss finish, faded stamp impressions. white background.

images.caption: Gold-foil chest print on orange fabric with holographic Protest-Kit sticker
images.prompt: Extreme macro of premium limited-edition merchandise foil, metallic gold stamped on safety-cone orange, a holographic limited-edition seal, hospitality-tier gloss, light raking across the foil. Full-bleed.

images.caption: Gold metallic pole-stripe over receipt-print field with neon marquee and Protest-Kit copy
images.prompt: A sleek vertical metallic gradient bar, safety-cone orange into merch gold with a neon-pink edge, a polished "pole" stripe, premium athletic trim finish, light hitting the metal. Full-bleed.

images.caption: Cover-charge stamp repeat pattern with rope stanchions and wristbands on white
images.prompt: A seamless repeating pattern of rubber-stamp "COVER CHARGE" and "PAID AT DOOR" marks, faded impressions, official seal texture, merch-gold and orange ink, density suitable for repeating down a sleeve. white background.

images.caption: Gold-to-pink gradient pole stripe with marquee crest and torn VIP wristband
images.prompt: A sleek vertical stripe, a metallic gradient from safety-cone orange through merch gold with a neon-pink edge, a polished "pole" stripe, athletic sportswear trim finish, suitable for a vertical torso accent. white background.

images.caption: Host-city shield crest with marquee sign, art-deco facade and velvet ropes
images.prompt: A heraldic host-city shield outline, inner art an orange theatre/stage marquee silhouette with a small bulb-lit sign, no people, safety-cone orange and merch gold with vinyl-black line work, official sports crest aesthetic, federal-badge style. white background.

images.caption: Circular neon-monogram crest reading Host City Bylaw inside gold rope ring
images.prompt: A heraldic shield, inner art a buzzing neon door marquee in marquee-pink and orange, a glowing tube-lettering shape with no legible text, no people, gold outline, white negative space, official badge style, nightlife-emblem aesthetic. white background.

stages.title: The Flats
stages.blurb: Technical jersey flats — front, back, the complete kit laid out.

images.caption: Home full kit flat: black jersey and shorts with orange SPECTACLE ECONOMY bar and gold 5
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of a unisex soccer jersey, vinyl-black body with safety-cone orange surcharge lines and small service-fee symbols printed across it, a marquee crest on the left chest, a center-chest sponsor bar in orange, clean away-style silhouette. white background.

images.caption: Black home jersey inside-hem close-up with gold-orange trim and itemized-tab microtext
images.prompt: Technical fashion flat detail of the lower hem interior, a printed thermal-receipt "tab" along the inside hem — itemized cover charge, drink minimum and "service fee" in faded mono type — vinyl-black body with orange and gold. white background.

images.caption: Away hero front flat: orange body, white sleeves, gold pillar stripe, WORK IS WORK panel
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of a unisex soccer jersey, glam away-kit silhouette, saturated safety-cone orange body with white sleeves and metallic merch-gold trim, a sleek vertical metallic "pole" stripe down the torso, a marquee crest on the left chest (host-city shield, orange stage marquee, no people), a bold VANCOUVER host-city wordmark across the upper chest (NOT "Vancouver Made"), a center-chest sponsor bar reading "WORK IS WORK" in gold. Clean line work, high detail, ready for production. white background.

images.caption: Away kit side/detail view: orange-white jersey with CAPITAL 5 receipt back and black shorts
images.prompt: Technical fashion flat of the complete away jersey showing side and sleeve detail, orange body with white sleeve, a sleeve cuff patch reading "UNLICENSED / UNPAID / UNAPOLOGETIC", the collar printed as a perforated tear-off VIP wristband band, gold cuff trim. white background.

images.caption: Home front flat: black jersey with orange cover-charge all-over print and VANCOUVER bar
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of a unisex soccer jersey, vinyl-black body with safety-cone orange surcharge lines and small service-fee symbols printed across it, a marquee crest on the left chest, a bold VANCOUVER host-city wordmark across the chest (NOT "Vancouver Made"), a center-chest sponsor bar in orange, clean away-style silhouette. white background.

images.caption: Orange home and away jersey pair with neon marquee crest and receipt back
images.prompt: A buzzing neon door marquee glowing over a darkened street, no people, neon marquee pink and safety-cone orange tubes, wet-asphalt reflection, late-night spectacle energy.

images.caption: Orange all-over jersey front and back featuring illustrated Gastown Hotel facade
images.prompt: An illustrated facade of an early-1900s brick corner hotel in old Gastown, warm streetlight, an orange marquee sign over the door, no people. Heritage architecture rendered as clean illustration, not a photograph. Reference-only interpretation.

images.caption: Glossy orange jersey close-up with thermal-receipt graphic listing cover charge and fees
images.prompt: Close-up of a printed thermal receipt, an itemized bar tab — line items reading cover charge, drink minimum, "service fee", gratuity — faded thermal mono type on a curling white paper roll, bureaucratic nightlife paperwork texture.

stages.title: On the Body
stages.blurb: Editorial lifestyle — the kit in the world, on people.

images.caption: Number Five Orange lifestyle — at a velvet-rope club entrance under a neon marquee, 'WORK IS WORK / COVER CHARGE' kit
Number Five Orange lifestyle — server carrying a tray on a wet Gastown nightlife strip at night
Number Five Orange lifestyle — supporters on a stadium concourse, gold scarf raised
Number Five Orange lifestyle — studio lookbook hero, orange/gold away kit with 'WORK IS WORK' lockup
Folded white-and-orange away jersey with VIP laminates, wristbands and receipts
images.prompt: Flat lay of official-looking tournament away-kit marketing materials, clean white-and-orange paneling, metallic-gold trim, a host-city sleeve-patch mockup, crisp broadcast polish, high-end event collateral. No real logos.

images.caption: Third-kit flat-lay: orange jersey with marquee crest plus VIP laminates and receipts
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of a unisex soccer jersey, dirty merch-gold over safety-cone orange, intentionally tacky premium-tier gloss, cover-charge stamps repeating down the sleeve, a marquee crest on the left chest, an official limited-edition stamp motif. white background.

images.caption: Away-kit flat-lay with white-orange-gold jersey, mountain crest, VIP lanyard, wristband and zine
images.prompt: Flat lay of official-looking tournament away-kit marketing materials, clean white-and-orange paneling, metallic-gold trim, a host-city sleeve-patch mockup, crisp broadcast polish, high-end event collateral. Any jersey shown reads VANCOUVER across the chest (not "Vancouver Made"). No real logos.

images.caption: Gold stanchion with orange velvet rope, pink wristband and Spectacle Economy door-list clipboard
images.prompt: Still life of a velvet VIP rope on a brass stanchion, a tear-off paper wristband, and a door-list clipboard. No people. Premium hospitality nightlife props, official-merch lighting.
